summary: Verified the two mobile bug fixes for HEARD app: (1) Bottom nav scrollable with padding for 'Made with Emergent' badge and (2) Coloring canvas full-screen on mobile with working flood-fill, recolor, eraser, and reset. All 10 requested test cases PASS on both mobile (375x812) and desktop (1920x800) viewports.

coloring_canvas_mobile.all_9_pages_load: PASS (Floral Bouquet, Heart Mandala, Flower Mandala, Mandala Pattern, Greek Mandala, Flower Heart, Ornate Mandala, Flower Circle, Lotus Bloom)

critical_code_review_comments: ColoringCanvas.js uses HTML5 canvas with custom flood-fill - currently functional. Max-channel line-detection (line 73) correctly allows recoloring saturated colors like red/blue/green.

AppLayout.js bottom-nav: overflow-x-auto with pr-52 (208px) on the inner row provides clearance for the 'Made with Emergent' external badge. scrollbar-hide hides the scrollbar bar while preserving scroll capability.
test_credentials: MongoDB session-based: user_id=test-1780119059235, session_token=test_1780119059235 (set via sessionStorage key 'heard_session_token').
seed_data_creation: Created one user (test@example.com) + user_session in MongoDB test_database. Auth tokens persisted via Playwright addInitScript.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All HEARD coloring + bottom nav fixes verified. Use page.context.add_init_script with sessionStorage.setItem('heard_session_token', '<token>') BEFORE goto. To open coloring canvas: calm-corner -> Creative filter -> Mini Coloring card -> scroll down -> 'Start Coloring' button (must scroll into view on mobile). To test flood fill, use canvas.click(position={x, y}) with offsets in DISPLAY coords (not canvas pixel coords). 18 palette colors with data-testid='palette-color-{HEX}', plus data-testid='eraser-btn', 'reset-coloring-btn', 'close-coloring-canvas', 'prev-page-btn', 'next-page-btn'. All bottom-nav-{name} data-testids work.
rca of the issue: Original bugs RCA: (1) Mobile bottom nav rightmost items hidden by external badge -> Fixed via overflow-x-auto + pr-52 padding. (2) Recoloring failed on saturated colors -> Old code used avg(r,g,b) < 100 as line detector which incorrectly classified red(255,0,0) avg=85 as a 'line'. Fixed by using max(r,g,b) < 100 (only true black qualifies as line).
